title: Jaanbaaz

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Kaali Aamar Maa
desc: Lakshmi's birth causes her mother's passing, yet Goddess Kali assumes a maternal role.

desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

desc: Chaitali, a rich girl, marries Arun against her family's wishes. Soon, their relationship turns sour and the bone of contention between the couple is the man's nephew.

desc: An aspiring young detective gets the chance to emulate his idol, the famous Bengali investigator Feluda, when a long-forgotten case reemerges during the Durga Puja festival.

desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Shesh Theke Shuru
desc: Mahid, a Dhaka-based businessman, falls in love with a girl on a flight to London. Soon enough, his relationship is threatened as his dark past resurfaces.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tarini Tarama
desc: Rajababu prohibits all religious devotion, causing villagers to oppose his oppressive deeds. Jasodha, his spouse, performs sacred worship secretly; ultimately, Rajababu converts to a staunch devotee.

desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Putrabadhu
desc: The members of a joint family go through various ups and downs in their lives and attempt to stay together despite all the odds stacked against them.

title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.
